name: per_selection
sql:
with al as (
  select 'Bet105'::text bk, a.player_a pa, a.player_b pb, a.side_player sp, fx.scheduled_start st, a.fixture_id fid, null::text eid, a.tier
    from ten280_bot.alerts a left join public.kibl_fixtures fx on fx.fixture_id = a.fixture_id
   where a.mode = 'live' and a.eval_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
  union all
  select a.book, a.player_a, a.player_b, a.side_player, ev.start_at, null::bigint, a.event_id::text, a.tier
    from ten287_bot.alerts a left join ten287_rec.events ev on ev.event_id = a.event_id
   where a.mode = 'live' and a.eval_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
), sel as (
  select distinct on (least(ten280_bot.skey(pa), ten280_bot.skey(pb)), greatest(ten280_bot.skey(pa), ten280_bot.skey(pb)), ten280_bot.skey(sp))
         pa, pb, sp, st, tier, ten280_bot.skey(pa) ka, ten280_bot.skey(pb) kb, ten280_bot.skey(sp) ks,
         max(fid) over w fid, max(eid) over w eid, string_agg(bk, ',') over w flagged
    from al
  window w as (partition by least(ten280_bot.skey(pa), ten280_bot.skey(pb)), greatest(ten280_bot.skey(pa), ten280_bot.skey(pb)), ten280_bot.skey(sp))
), ev as (
  select s.*, (select e.event_id from ten287_rec.events e
                where least(ten280_bot.skey(e.home), ten280_bot.skey(e.away)) = least(s.ka, s.kb)
                  and greatest(ten280_bot.skey(e.home), ten280_bot.skey(e.away)) = greatest(s.ka, s.kb)
                  and (s.st is null or abs(extract(epoch from e.start_at - s.st)) < 43200)
                order by abs(extract(epoch from e.start_at - coalesce(s.st, e.start_at))) limit 1) ev_id,
              (select f.fixture_id from public.kibl_fixtures f
                where f.scheduled_start > now() - interval '2 days' and f.scheduled_start < now() + interval '2 days'
                  and least(ten280_bot.skey(f.player1_name), ten280_bot.skey(f.player2_name)) = least(s.ka, s.kb)
                  and greatest(ten280_bot.skey(f.player1_name), ten280_bot.skey(f.player2_name)) = greatest(s.ka, s.kb)
                  and (s.st is null or abs(extract(epoch from f.scheduled_start - s.st)) < 43200)
                order by abs(extract(epoch from f.scheduled_start - coalesce(s.st, f.scheduled_start))) limit 1) kfx
    from sel s
), q as (
  select e.*,
    exists (select 1 from ten287_rec.ticks k join ten287_rec.events x on x.event_id = k.event_id
             where k.event_id = e.ev_id and k.book = 'Superbet' and k.book_updated_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
               and coalesce(k.event_status, x.status) = 'pending'
               and case when ten280_bot.skey(x.home) = e.ks then k.back_home else k.back_away end >= 1.01) q_superbet,
    exists (select 1 from ten287_rec.ticks k join ten287_rec.events x on x.event_id = k.event_id
             where k.event_id = e.ev_id and k.book = 'Betfair Exchange' and k.book_updated_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
               and coalesce(k.event_status, x.status) = 'pending'
               and case when ten280_bot.skey(x.home) = e.ks then k.back_home else k.back_away end >= 1.01) q_bfe,
    exists (select 1 from public.kibl_line_observations o join public.kibl_fixtures f on f.fixture_id = o.fixture_id
             where o.fixture_id = coalesce(e.fid, e.kfx) and o.market_type_id = 1 and o.segment_id = 1 and o.feed_source_id = 171
               and o.betting_type_id = 1 and o.is_live is false and o.price_decimal >= 1.01
               and o.side_id = case when ten280_bot.skey(f.player1_name) = e.ks then 2 when ten280_bot.skey(f.player2_name) = e.ks then 3 end) q_bet105
    from ev e
)
select tier, sp, pa, pb, flagged, ev_id is not null has_ev, coalesce(fid,kfx) is not null has_kfx, q_bet105, q_superbet, q_bfe, (q_bet105::int + q_superbet::int + q_bfe::int) n_books from q order by n_books desc, tier

    exists (select 1 from ten287_rec.ticks k join ten287_rec.events x on x.event_id = k.event_id
             where k.event_id = e.ev_id and k.book = 'Betfair Exchange' and k.book_updated_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
               and coalesce(k.event_status, x.status) = 'pending'
               and case when ten280_bot.skey(x.home) = e.ks then k.back_home else k.back_away end >= 1.01) q_bfe,
    exists (select 1 from public.kibl_line_observations o join public.kibl_fixtures f on f.fixture_id = o.fixture_id
             where o.fixture_id = coalesce(e.fid, e.kfx) and o.market_type_id = 1 and o.segment_id = 1 and o.feed_source_id = 171
               and o.betting_type_id = 1 and o.is_live is false and o.price_decimal >= 1.01
               and o.side_id = case when ten280_bot.skey(f.player1_name) = e.ks then 2 when ten280_bot.skey(f.player2_name) = e.ks then 3 end) q_bet105
    from ev e
)
select tier, (q_bet105::int + q_superbet::int + q_bfe::int) n_books, count(*) selections from q group by 1,2 order by 1,2
